newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania forex reserves rise to $1.869 bln in June.
newsitem.headline: Romania forex reserves rise to $1.869 bln in June.

text.p: Romania's foreign exchange reserves went up to $1.869 billion in June from $1.715 billion at end-May as the country continued to raise funds from international capital markets, National Bank data showed.
Romania's central bank drew $225 million in three-year Eurobonds in June, after raising 52 billion yen in three-year samurais in May.
Data on BNR's own forex reserves were not available.
